body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then turn this round's approval notes into candidate Experience rows: one lesson per row, each linked to its source reply or action, with my exact words quoted in the approval-quote field. Leave every new row as a candidate — adoption is my call at the weekly review.

body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run the weekly review for Experience: for each candidate, show the lesson, its evidence and where it was re-validated; recommend adopt, keep as candidate, or retire. For lessons proven repeatedly, draft the exact Skill change as a diff. Change no statuses and promote nothing until I confirm.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹的 `busa-linkedin-desk` skill 并遵循其工作流程，然后做经验表的周复盘：逐条给出候选经验、它的证据和再次验证的情况，建议采纳、保留候选或废止。对反复验证成立的，给出晋升进 Skill 的确切改动 diff。在我确认前不要改任何状态、不要晋升任何一条。
